title: Add Quotation/PI to Sales Order prefill
description: Complete the audited downstream conversion gap without touching legacy sales-order stored procedures: add Quotation -> Sales Order and Proforma Invoice -> Sales Order prefill/create flows on the existing EF sales-order path introduced by ERP-008. Preserve source traceability and reuse existing sales/order conventions. Production database, deployment and irreversible actions remain out of scope.
acceptance_criteria: Quotation and Proforma Invoice each expose a user-visible action that creates or prefills a Sales Order on the EF sales-order workflow.
Customer, currency, trade/payment terms, destination, Consignee/Notify/marks and sellable detail lines are mapped deterministically; quantities, prices and totals are revalidated server-side.
The created Sales Order preserves source quotation/PI traceability using the ERP-008 source fields and does not silently overwrite an existing order.
Repeated conversion is idempotent or explicitly guarded so accidental double-clicks do not create duplicate downstream documents.
Unit/integration tests cover both source types, field mapping, duplicate protection and invalid source states; existing safe validation remains green.
Real Edge acceptance covers Quotation -> Sales Order and PI -> Sales Order with saved/reopened values and no JS/API errors.

scenarios: Convert an approved Quotation to a Sales Order, reopen it and verify source traceability plus mapped header/detail values.
Convert an approved PI to a Sales Order and verify mapped values, totals and source PI traceability.
Attempt the same conversion twice and verify duplicate downstream creation is prevented.

human_gate.reason: User explicitly requested continuous NEWERP feature development. This task is limited to application code and test data; production database/deployment/irreversible actions remain separately gated.
